Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Producer prices DE: fasteners and screw machine products changed +1.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2594@2025-08, idx:PPI-C2594@2026-08).
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
We placed our last 3 orders for part part:360012 at EUR 4.91 per 100 units (po:4500014466-10, po:4500014414-10, po:4500014353-10).
Which of the packages in our term sheet works best for you?

move.text:
Dear customer,
Thank you very much for your message - it is always a pleasure to hear from you, and we are glad to help wherever we can.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months.
A few words on this from our side.
We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part.
Your figures confirm our case: that driver rose.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We have reviewed the historical data for part 360012; however, this quotation encompasses a complete kit, which is reflected in the overall unit price.
We are pleased to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms.
With these terms in place, we can offer a revised price of €5.56 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your revised offer and for moving in our direction. We value our ongoing business partnership with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and always aim to provide you with the best support from our extensive product range and dedicated service. 

We are pleased to offer a further concession, bringing our price down to €5.45 per unit. This represents a highly competitive rate for the complete fastener kit under the agreed 24-month contract and 60-day payment terms. 

To confirm our exact parameters, our offer stands at a price of €5.45 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide within 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
